parameters.content:
# Trigger - Form Submission

This workflow starts when someone fills out the membership form.

Fill in the form at: YOUR_N8N_URL/form/YOUR_FORM_PATH

The form collects:
- First name, last name
- Email address
- Company name
- Role / position
- Birthday
- How they found the community
- Any other info they want to share

After submission, the data is sanitized (cleaned up) and passed to the AI Agent for vetting.

# AI Vetting - Candidate Analysis

The AI Agent (Google Gemini) reviews every applicant automatically.

It has access to:
- The applicant data from the form
- Web search (Firecrawl) to research their company
- LinkedIn profile lookup via Apify (RapidAPI)
- A calculator for any math needed
- A memory buffer for context

The AI checks each candidate against your community criteria and outputs a structured recommendation:
- Immediate approval
- Review needed (sends to human)
- Rejection

Edit the AI Agent system message to set YOUR community criteria (e.g. AI interest, experience level, industry).

# Human Approval Gate

After AI vetting, results are sent to your Telegram bot.

You receive a message showing:
- Candidate name and current role
- Professional background summary
- AI vetting decision and reasoning
- Community fit score

## Two Paths After Vetting
**✅ Strong candidate** → sent straight to your Telegram. No waiting.

**⏳ Needs approval** → summary sent to your Telegram with 3 options:
1 = Approve → welcome email sent
2 = Reject → polite rejection sent
3 = Skip → no action taken

# Community Onboarding Template

### How it works

This template automates your membership application process. When someone submits the form, an AI (Google Gemini) vets each candidate using web search and LinkedIn lookup. The AI recommends approve, review, or reject — then a human (you) makes the final call via Telegram. Approved candidates get a welcome email; all decisions are logged to Google Sheets.

### Setup

Before enabling, set up these credentials in their respective nodes:
1. Telegram Bot (chatId + bot token)
2. Google Gemini (API key)
3. Tavily (API key — tavily.com)
4. Apify  (LinkedIn scraper key)
5. Google Sheets (sheet ID + Drive access)

Also replace the form URL path, Telegram chat IDs, and sheet ID placeholders in each node.

### Customization

Edit the AI Agent system message to match YOUR community criteria. The Switch node routes based on the AI decision — adjust the routing logic if your flow differs. you can edit the form to capture more information and route as you see fit. 

Have fun with it 😉👌

## Google Sheets Log

Every decision is recorded automatically: name, email, company, AI vetting result, your decision, and timestamp.
